Function: Used to check the configuration after generation
Author: Nguyen Hung Quan (user)

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Audio interface version register. Reports the major and minor release numbers of this IP.

Bits.Description:
Major version number. A change marks an incompatible register or behavior change.

Usage: Read once after reset so that the driver selects the matching programming model; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0001 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the IP release.

Minor version number. A change marks a compatible addition.

Usage: Read once after reset for diagnostics; software never writes it.

Values:
0x0000 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: fixed by the IP release.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Audio interface capability register. Reports which units, lines and options this build contains.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Extended formats present. Tells whether formats other than the Philips frame and slot counts above 2 are built.

Usage: Read at probe time before choosing fmt or nslot.

Values:
0x0 Philips frame, 2 slots only;
0x1 all formats (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

DMA handshake present. Tells whether the request and acknowledge pins exist.

Usage: Read at probe time before setting dma in a control register.

Values:
0x0 not present;
0x1 present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Timeout detector present. Tells whether the hung-clock timer exists.

Usage: Read at probe time before programming a timeout.

Values:
0x0 not present;
0x1 present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Slot tri-state present. Tells whether masked transmit slots can release the data lines.

Usage: Read at probe time before setting tri.

Values:
0x0 not present;
0x1 present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

On-demand frame start present. Tells whether a master can wait for FIFO data or space before starting a frame.

Usage: Read at probe time before setting ondem.

Values:
0x0 not present;
0x1 present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Bit clock divider present. Tells whether the unit can act as master with an internal bit clock.

Usage: Read at probe time before setting role to master.

Values:
0x0 slave only;
0x1 master and slave (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Packing present. Tells whether two 16-bit samples can share one FIFO word.

Usage: Read at probe time before setting pack in a frame register.

Values:
0x0 no packing;
0x1 packing present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Largest frame length. The number of slots per frame cannot exceed this value.

Usage: Read at probe time; program nslot of each unit not above it.

Values:
0x02 to 0x20 maximum number of slots (reset value 0x20).

Unit: slots.

Limits: 2 or more.

FIFO depth as a power of two. The depth of the FIFO of every data line is two to this power.

Usage: Read at probe time; the logical FIFO of a unit holds depth times the line count words.

Values:
0x1 to 0x8 depth 2, 4, ..., 256 words (reset value 0x4, depth 16).

Unit: log2 of words.

Limits: fixed by the build.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Number of receive data lines. Each line carries the whole frame in parallel.

Usage: Read at probe time to size the data order of the receive data register.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 0 to 4 lines (reset value 0x1).

Unit: lines.

Limits: 0 when the receiver is absent.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Number of transmit data lines. Each line carries the whole frame in parallel.

Usage: Read at probe time to size the data order of the transmit data register.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 0 to 4 lines (reset value 0x1).

Unit: lines.

Limits: 0 when the transmitter is absent.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Receiver present. Tells whether the receive unit exists in this build.

Usage: Read at probe time; when 0 every register of the receive block is inactive.

Values:
0x0 no receiver;
0x1 receiver present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Transmitter present. Tells whether the transmit unit exists in this build.

Usage: Read at probe time; when 0 every register of the transmit block reads 0 and ignores writes in effect.

Values:
0x0 no transmitter;
0x1 transmitter present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Audio interface global control register. Resets both units and selects the frame-done source.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Frame-done source. Chooses which unit raises the frame-done interrupt at the end of each frame.

Usage: Write before enabling the frame-done interrupt.

Values:
0x0 transmitter (reset value);
0x1 receiver.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Global soft reset. Writing 1 resets both units, their FIFOs and their status; the configuration registers keep their values and the bit clears itself.

Usage: Write 1 to recover from a fault; disable both units first when a clean stream stop is wanted. Reads return 0.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 reset both units.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Audio interface global status register. Summarizes the state of both units and of the interrupt.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Interrupt pending. High while at least one unmasked interrupt cause is set.

Usage: Read in an interrupt handler as a quick check.

Values:
0x0 no unmasked cause (reset value);
0x1 at least one unmasked cause.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Receiver busy. High from the enable of the receiver until it has finished its last frame after a disable.

Usage: Poll it after clearing the enable to know when the unit has really stopped.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Transmitter busy. High from the enable of the transmitter until it has finished its last frame after a disable.

Usage: Poll it after clearing the enable to know when the unit has really stopped.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Audio interrupt raw status register. Holds the sticky interrupt causes before masking.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Frame done. One frame of the unit selected by i2s_ctrl.frm_sel has completed. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Clear after counting the frame.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Hung clock. No bit clock or frame sync arrived within the programmed timeout. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Read i2s_tx_sts and i2s_rx_sts to find the unit, clear both flags.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Frame sync error. An external frame sync arrived while the unit was still running the previous frame. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Read i2s_tx_sts and i2s_rx_sts to find the unit, clear both flags.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Receive overrun. A received word found the receive FIFO full and was dropped. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Drain, flush and clear when auto restart is off.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Receive FIFO at or above its watermark. Level cause: it stays set while the condition holds. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Drain the receive FIFO, then clear.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Transmit overrun. A write to the transmit data register found the FIFO full and was dropped. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Clear after reducing the write burst.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Transmit underrun. A slot needed a word and the transmit FIFO was empty; the slot sent zeros. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Read i2s_tx_sts, flush and clear when auto restart is off.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Transmit FIFO at or below its watermark. Level cause: it stays set while the condition holds. Set by hardware.

Usage: Read to see the cause; write 1 to clear. Refill the transmit FIFO, then clear.

Values:
0x0 no cause (reset value);
0x1 cause set.

Unit: none.

Limits: a level cause is set again at once while its condition holds.

Usage: Set the bit to let the raw cause drive the interrupt output; clear it to mask the cause.

Unit: none.

Unit: none.

Enable of the cause: Transmit underrun. A slot needed a word and the transmit FIFO was empty; the slot sent zeros.

Usage: Set the bit to let the raw cause drive the interrupt output; clear it to mask the cause.

Values:
0x0 masked (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Enable of the cause: Transmit FIFO at or below its watermark. Level cause: it stays set while the condition holds.

Usage: Set the bit to let the raw cause drive the interrupt output; clear it to mask the cause.

Values:
0x0 masked (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit control register. Starts and stops the transmit unit and selects its role and options.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

DMA request enable. Connects the watermark condition of the FIFO to the DMA request output.

Usage: Set it when a DMA controller serves the data register; keep the watermark interrupt masked in that case.

Values:
0x0 no DMA request (reset value);
0x1 DMA request enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Release masked slots. Masked slots release the data lines (high impedance) instead of driving zeros; used on shared TDM lines.

Usage: Set it when several devices share one data line.

Values:
0x0 masked slots drive zero (reset value);
0x1 masked slots release the line.

Unit: none.

Limits: transmitter only.

Auto restart. After an underrun or overrun the unit resumes by itself at the start of the first frame for which the FIFO is ready; otherwise it stays in the error state until a flush.

Usage: Set it for streaming that must recover without software; clear the error flag after a recovery.

Values:
0x0 stay in error until flush (reset value);
0x1 restart at a frame boundary.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

On-demand frame start. A master starts a frame only when the FIFO holds a whole frame of data (transmit) or has room for it (receive).

Usage: Set it to stall instead of underrun or overrun when the processor or DMA is slow; the frame sync waits.

Values:
0x0 frames run continuously (reset value);
0x1 frames wait for data or room.

Unit: none.

Limits: effective in master mode only.

Share clock. The unit uses the bit clock and frame sync of the other unit instead of its own.

Usage: Set it for full duplex codecs that use one clock pair; do not set it in both units.

Values:
0x0 own clock and sync (reset value);
0x1 use the other unit's clock and sync.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Transmit role. Master generates the bit clock and frame sync from the master clock; slave follows the external ones.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped. Master needs the divider feature in the build.

Values:
0x0 slave (reset value);
0x1 master.

Unit: none.

Limits: slave mode needs a master clock at least 8 times the bit clock.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Transmit FIFO flush. Writing 1 empties the FIFO of the unit and clears its error latch; the bit clears itself.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped, or after an underrun or overrun when auto restart is off. Reads return 0.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 flush the FIFO.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Transmit soft reset. Writing 1 resets the unit, its FIFO and its status; the configuration keeps its values and the bit clears itself.

Usage: Use it to recover after an error; stop the unit first for a clean stop. Reads return 0.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 reset the unit.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Transmit enable. Starts the unit with the configuration latched at the rising edge of this bit; clearing it stops the unit at the end of the running frame.

Usage: Program every other register of the block first, fill the FIFO for the transmitter, then set the bit; clear it and poll the busy flag to stop.

Values:
0x0 unit stopped (reset value);
0x1 unit running.

Unit: none.

Limits: configuration written while the bit is 1 is not used until the next start.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit frame register. Selects the frame format, the number of slots, and the slot and data widths.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Data width. Number of valid sample bits at the start of a slot, most significant bit first; the rest of the slot is zero (transmit) or ignored (receive).

Usage: Write the real width of the sample.

Values:
0x08 to 0x20 8 to 32 bits (reset value 0x20).

Unit: bits.

Limits: not larger than slot_w.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Slot width. Number of bit clocks of one slot.

Usage: Write the real width; it must be at least the data width.

Values:
0x08 to 0x20 8 to 32 bits (reset value 0x20).

Unit: bit clocks.

Limits: not smaller than data_w.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Slots per frame. Number of time slots in one frame; a stereo I2S frame has 2.

Usage: Write the real number of slots, not a minus-one code; the slot mask refers to slots from 0.

Values:
0x01 to 0x20 1 to 32 slots (reset value 0x02).

Unit: slots.

Limits: not above the build maximum of i2s_cap.max_slot.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Packing. Puts two 16-bit samples in one FIFO word, first sample in the low half.

Usage: Set it for voice paths to halve the DMA traffic; data_w must be 16 or less.

Values:
0x0 one sample per word (reset value);
0x1 two samples per word.

Unit: none.

Limits: needs the packing feature.

Sample alignment in the FIFO word. Chooses whether a sample sits in the low or the high bits of the 32-bit word.

Usage: Choose the alignment that matches the software data layout.

Values:
0x0 right aligned: sample in the low bits (reset value);
0x1 left aligned: sample in the high bits.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit frame sync register. Defines the frame sync shape for the custom format and the bit clock polarity.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Bit clock polarity. Selects the clock edge that launches data and the edge that samples it.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped; the standard I2S edges are the default.

Values:
0x0 launch on the falling edge, sample on the rising edge (reset value);
0x1 launch on the rising edge, sample on the falling edge.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Frame sync early. Chooses whether the frame sync starts one bit clock before the first bit or together with it.

Usage: Used only with fmt custom.

Values:
0x0 with the first bit;
0x1 one bit clock early (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Frame sync polarity. Selects the active level of the frame sync.

Usage: Used only with fmt custom.

Values:
0x0 active high (reset value);
0x1 active low.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Frame sync width. Number of bit clocks the frame sync is active at the start of a frame.

Usage: Used only with fmt custom; the preset formats set it themselves.

Values:
0x01 to 0x20 1 to 32 bit clocks (reset value 0x01).

Unit: bit clocks.

Limits: not longer than slot_w.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit clock register. Sets the bit clock divider of the master.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Bit clock divider. Number of master clock cycles in each half period of the bit clock, so the bit clock is the master clock divided by twice this value.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped; used only in master mode. Example: master clock 12.288 MHz and divider 2 give a 3.072 MHz bit clock.

Values:
0x0001 to 0xFFFF half period in master clock cycles (reset value 0x0002).

Unit: master clock cycles.

Limits: 1 or more in master mode.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit slot mask register. Enables the slots of the frame one by one.

Bits.Description:
Slot mask. Bit n enables slot n; a masked slot is skipped: no word is taken from or put into the FIFO, and a transmit slot sends zero or releases the line.

Usage: May be written while the unit runs; the new value applies at the start of the next frame, so a frame is never changed in the middle.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF one bit per slot (reset value 0xFFFFFFFF, all slots enabled).

Unit: none.

Limits: bits above nslot are ignored.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit FIFO register. Sets the watermark of the logical FIFO.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Watermark. The watermark cause and the DMA request are active while the number of words in the FIFO is at or below this value.

Usage: Choose it from the service latency: see the sizing rule of the specification.

Values:
0x000 to 0x400 words (reset value 0x004).

Unit: words.

Limits: not above the FIFO capacity.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit status register. Shows the state of the unit and the FIFO.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

FIFO level. Number of words in the logical FIFO of all lines.

Usage: Read to size a burst: the free space is the capacity minus the level.

Values:
0x000 to 0x400 words in the FIFO (reset value 0x000).

Unit: words.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Hung clock of this unit. No bit clock or frame sync arrived within the timeout.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after reading i2s_irq_raw.hung.

Values:
0x0 no timeout (reset value);
0x1 timeout occurred.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Frame sync error of this unit. An external frame sync arrived while a frame was running.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after reading i2s_irq_raw.sync.

Values:
0x0 no error (reset value);
0x1 error occurred.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

FIFO full flag. High when the logical FIFO of the unit has no room for another word.

Usage: Check it before writing a burst.

Values:
0x0 room available (reset value);
0x1 full.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

FIFO empty flag. High when the logical FIFO of the unit holds no word at all.

Usage: Poll it to know that a transmit stream has been sent out of the FIFO.

Values:
0x0 words present;
0x1 empty (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Unit busy. High while the unit is running or finishing a frame.

Usage: Poll it after clearing en.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit data register. Write port of the transmit FIFO; software writes the samples of the frame in order.

Bits.Description:
Transmit data. Each write pushes one word. The order is slot by slot over the enabled slots, and inside a slot line 0 first and then the other lines.

Usage: Write whole frames; with DMA point the DMA destination to this one address without incrementing. A write to a full FIFO is dropped and sets i2s_irq_raw.tx_ovr. Reads return 0.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF sample word; with pack the low half is the first sample.

Unit: sample.

Limits: valid bits follow data_w and align.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Transmit timeout register. Sets the hung-clock timeout of the unit.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Timeout. When the unit is running and no bit clock edge or frame sync arrives for this time, the hung cause is raised.

Usage: Set it in slave mode to detect a lost clock; 0 turns the detector off.

Values:
0x0000 detector off (reset value);
0x0001 to 0xFFFF timeout in units of 256 master clock cycles.

Unit: 256 master clock cycles.

Limits: needs the timeout feature.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive control register. Starts and stops the receive unit and selects its role and options.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

DMA request enable. Connects the watermark condition of the FIFO to the DMA request output.

Usage: Set it when a DMA controller serves the data register; keep the watermark interrupt masked in that case.

Values:
0x0 no DMA request (reset value);
0x1 DMA request enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Release masked slots. Present for a uniform layout; it has no effect in the receiver.

Usage: Set it when several devices share one data line.

Values:
0x0 masked slots drive zero (reset value);
0x1 masked slots release the line.

Unit: none.

Limits: transmitter only.

Auto restart. After an underrun or overrun the unit resumes by itself at the start of the first frame for which the FIFO is ready; otherwise it stays in the error state until a flush.

Usage: Set it for streaming that must recover without software; clear the error flag after a recovery.

Values:
0x0 stay in error until flush (reset value);
0x1 restart at a frame boundary.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

On-demand frame start. A master starts a frame only when the FIFO holds a whole frame of data (transmit) or has room for it (receive).

Usage: Set it to stall instead of underrun or overrun when the processor or DMA is slow; the frame sync waits.

Values:
0x0 frames run continuously (reset value);
0x1 frames wait for data or room.

Unit: none.

Limits: effective in master mode only.

Share clock. The unit uses the bit clock and frame sync of the other unit instead of its own.

Usage: Set it for full duplex codecs that use one clock pair; do not set it in both units.

Values:
0x0 own clock and sync (reset value);
0x1 use the other unit's clock and sync.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Receive role. Master generates the bit clock and frame sync from the master clock; slave follows the external ones.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped. Master needs the divider feature in the build.

Values:
0x0 slave (reset value);
0x1 master.

Unit: none.

Limits: slave mode needs a master clock at least 8 times the bit clock.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Receive FIFO flush. Writing 1 empties the FIFO of the unit and clears its error latch; the bit clears itself.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped, or after an underrun or overrun when auto restart is off. Reads return 0.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 flush the FIFO.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Receive soft reset. Writing 1 resets the unit, its FIFO and its status; the configuration keeps its values and the bit clears itself.

Usage: Use it to recover after an error; stop the unit first for a clean stop. Reads return 0.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 reset the unit.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Receive enable. Starts the unit with the configuration latched at the rising edge of this bit; clearing it stops the unit at the end of the running frame.

Usage: Program every other register of the block first, fill the FIFO for the transmitter, then set the bit; clear it and poll the busy flag to stop.

Values:
0x0 unit stopped (reset value);
0x1 unit running.

Unit: none.

Limits: configuration written while the bit is 1 is not used until the next start.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive frame register. Selects the frame format, the number of slots, and the slot and data widths.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Data width. Number of valid sample bits at the start of a slot, most significant bit first; the rest of the slot is zero (transmit) or ignored (receive).

Usage: Write the real width of the sample.

Values:
0x08 to 0x20 8 to 32 bits (reset value 0x20).

Unit: bits.

Limits: not larger than slot_w.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Slot width. Number of bit clocks of one slot.

Usage: Write the real width; it must be at least the data width.

Values:
0x08 to 0x20 8 to 32 bits (reset value 0x20).

Unit: bit clocks.

Limits: not smaller than data_w.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Slots per frame. Number of time slots in one frame; a stereo I2S frame has 2.

Usage: Write the real number of slots, not a minus-one code; the slot mask refers to slots from 0.

Values:
0x01 to 0x20 1 to 32 slots (reset value 0x02).

Unit: slots.

Limits: not above the build maximum of i2s_cap.max_slot.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Packing. Puts two 16-bit samples in one FIFO word, first sample in the low half.

Usage: Set it for voice paths to halve the DMA traffic; data_w must be 16 or less.

Values:
0x0 one sample per word (reset value);
0x1 two samples per word.

Unit: none.

Limits: needs the packing feature.

Sample alignment in the FIFO word. Chooses whether a sample sits in the low or the high bits of the 32-bit word.

Usage: Choose the alignment that matches the software data layout.

Values:
0x0 right aligned: sample in the low bits (reset value);
0x1 left aligned: sample in the high bits.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive frame sync register. Defines the frame sync shape for the custom format and the bit clock polarity.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Bit clock polarity. Selects the clock edge that launches data and the edge that samples it.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped; the standard I2S edges are the default.

Values:
0x0 launch on the falling edge, sample on the rising edge (reset value);
0x1 launch on the rising edge, sample on the falling edge.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Frame sync early. Chooses whether the frame sync starts one bit clock before the first bit or together with it.

Usage: Used only with fmt custom.

Values:
0x0 with the first bit;
0x1 one bit clock early (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Frame sync polarity. Selects the active level of the frame sync.

Usage: Used only with fmt custom.

Values:
0x0 active high (reset value);
0x1 active low.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Frame sync width. Number of bit clocks the frame sync is active at the start of a frame.

Usage: Used only with fmt custom; the preset formats set it themselves.

Values:
0x01 to 0x20 1 to 32 bit clocks (reset value 0x01).

Unit: bit clocks.

Limits: not longer than slot_w.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive clock register. Sets the bit clock divider of the master.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Bit clock divider. Number of master clock cycles in each half period of the bit clock, so the bit clock is the master clock divided by twice this value.

Usage: Write while the unit is stopped; used only in master mode. Example: master clock 12.288 MHz and divider 2 give a 3.072 MHz bit clock.

Values:
0x0001 to 0xFFFF half period in master clock cycles (reset value 0x0002).

Unit: master clock cycles.

Limits: 1 or more in master mode.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive slot mask register. Enables the slots of the frame one by one.

Bits.Description:
Slot mask. Bit n enables slot n; a masked slot is skipped: no word is taken from or put into the FIFO, and a transmit slot sends zero or releases the line.

Usage: May be written while the unit runs; the new value applies at the start of the next frame, so a frame is never changed in the middle.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF one bit per slot (reset value 0xFFFFFFFF, all slots enabled).

Unit: none.

Limits: bits above nslot are ignored.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive FIFO register. Sets the watermark of the logical FIFO.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Watermark. The watermark cause and the DMA request are active while the number of words in the FIFO is at or above this value.

Usage: Choose it from the service latency: see the sizing rule of the specification.

Values:
0x000 to 0x400 words (reset value 0x004).

Unit: words.

Limits: not above the FIFO capacity.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive status register. Shows the state of the unit and the FIFO.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

FIFO level. Number of words in the logical FIFO of all lines.

Usage: Read to size a burst: the free space is the capacity minus the level.

Values:
0x000 to 0x400 words in the FIFO (reset value 0x000).

Unit: words.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Hung clock of this unit. No bit clock or frame sync arrived within the timeout.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after reading i2s_irq_raw.hung.

Values:
0x0 no timeout (reset value);
0x1 timeout occurred.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Frame sync error of this unit. An external frame sync arrived while a frame was running.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after reading i2s_irq_raw.sync.

Values:
0x0 no error (reset value);
0x1 error occurred.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

FIFO full flag. High when the logical FIFO of the unit has no room for another word.

Usage: Check it before writing a burst.

Values:
0x0 room available (reset value);
0x1 full.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

FIFO empty flag. High when the logical FIFO of the unit holds no word at all.

Usage: Poll it to know that a transmit stream has been sent out of the FIFO.

Values:
0x0 words present;
0x1 empty (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Unit busy. High while the unit is running or finishing a frame.

Usage: Poll it after clearing en.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive data register. Read port of the receive FIFO; software reads the samples of the frame in order.

Bits.Description:
Receive data. Each read pops one word. The order is slot by slot over the enabled slots, and inside a slot line 0 first and then the other lines.

Usage: Read whole frames; with DMA point the DMA source to this one address without incrementing. A read of an empty FIFO returns 0.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF sample word; with pack the low half is the first sample.

Unit: sample.

Limits: valid bits follow data_w and align.

Table - Register Definition.Descriprtion: Receive timeout register. Sets the hung-clock timeout of the unit.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Timeout. When the unit is running and no bit clock edge or frame sync arrives for this time, the hung cause is raised.

Usage: Set it in slave mode to detect a lost clock; 0 turns the detector off.

Values:
0x0000 detector off (reset value);
0x0001 to 0xFFFF timeout in units of 256 master clock cycles.

Unit: 256 master clock cycles.

Limits: needs the timeout feature.
